This advice preserves the PASS verdict and recommends verification and reruns with supported observation counts, not causal conclusions.

hypotheses.possible_explanation: The load generator may have scaled concurrency from 3 to 6 threads partway through workload-01 while per-thread pacing kept the target at 60 rps; this would be a test-operator-defined load-profile step rather than evidence of system degradation.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Inspect the JMeter thread-group/ramp configuration and generator logs to confirm the 3-to-6 thread step was intended, and verify achieved request_starts stayed at 60 rps during the step.
